text:
Anna (Design): Hey team — dropping the next iteration of the latency & throughput observability UI. Focus areas: p95 visual prominence, optional p99, heatmap density, time-range picker, and sampling/fidelity controls. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/XXXXX/latency-observability

Miguel (Product): This looks promising. My ask: p95 should be the default metric but customers often ask for p99. Make toggling between them quick.

Sofia (Eng-Platform): p95 default is fine. Operational question: computing exact p99 across high-cardinality routes and long ranges can be expensive.

Mark (Eng-ML): Agree with Sofia. Suggestation: provide an approximate p99 for wide ranges via reservoir sampling; compute exact p99 only for selected routes or when user requests it.

Anna (Design): UI proposal: main solid line = p95, secondary dotted line = p99 (dotted only when enabled). Add inline helper: "p99 may be approximate for ranges > 24h". Thoughts?

Miguel (Product): Love the helper. Also add a small indicator near the metric selector: "approx" when approximation is in effect.

Jules (Accessibility): Accessibility nits: the dotted p99 color is too low contrast against the chart background. Please meet 4.5:1 contrast. Also keyboard focus must be visible on the metric toggle.

Anna (Design): Noted — I'll increase contrast and add a clear focus ring on the toggle.

Sofia (Eng-Platform): About the heatmap: are we planning to render from sampled events or pre-aggregated counters per bucket/minute? Sampling reduces cost but can hide spikes.

Mark (Eng-ML): For scale, use aggregated counters per latency bucket per minute. Expose sampling level controls so users can trade cost vs fidelity.

Anna (Design): Draft control copy: "Sampling: Auto / Low / Medium / High" with a tooltip: "Lower sampling reduces query cost; higher sampling improves accuracy for tail metrics." Better phrasing?

Miguel (Product): Consider shorter label in compact UI: "Fidelity" (with hover text "Sampling level"). Keeps the UI approachable for non-devs.

Jules (Accessibility): Ensure the sampling control has aria-describedby linking to the tooltip content. Also don't rely on color alone to show sampling state (add icons/text).

Anna (Design): Will include accessible labels, icons, and non-color indicators.

Sofia (Eng-Platform): Time-range presets proposed: Last 15m, 1h, 6h, 24h, 7d, Custom. For ranges >24h show a subtle banner: "Data older than 24h may be downsampled." Clamp max selectable range to 90d and require confirmation if users pick >90d.

Anna (Design): I'll add the inline banner and the custom-range confirmation modal for >90d.

Mark (Eng-ML): Auto-aggregation suggestion: when a long range is selected, the heatmap should coarsen buckets automatically; expose "Auto-aggregate for long ranges" toggle (default on).

Miguel (Product): Also propose adding mini-sparklines in the routes list showing p95 trend for quick scanning. Users can click to open the full route view.

Sofia (Eng-Platform): Sparklines can be generated from precomputed aggregates and are cheap, but we should cap the number of routes fetched in one call to avoid perf spikes.

Anna (Design): UX details: legend order should prioritize selected/active series first. Add drag handles for power users to reorder, but include keyboard alternatives.

Jules (Accessibility): If supporting drag reorder, provide alternative "Move up / Move down" actions in the legend context menu so keyboard-only users can reorder.

design-bot: Updated Figma v4 uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/XXXXX/latency-observability (comments enabled).

Miguel (Product): Minor copy tweak: change "Sampling" label to "Data fidelity" in compact mode. Test both variants in A/B.

Anna (Design): Will add both labels to the comps (full vs compact).

Sofia (Eng-Platform): Implementation note: we'll support a sampling_level query param and an "X-Exact-Tail" header to request exact tail calculations when the caller accepts higher cost (useful for Dedicated customers).

Mark (Eng-ML): Also plan a server-side feature-gate to allow exact tail queries for enterprise plans.

Anna (Design): I'll update mocks for: contrast changes, keyboard focus, legend reordering with keyboard menu, time-range wording, sampling label variants, and the approximate p99 helper. Will ping with Figma v4.1.

Miguel (Product): Please include a changelog note in Figma comments listing behavioral changes (auto-aggregate, approximate p99 rules, sampling semantics).

Jules (Accessibility): I'll run an a11y pass after the next update (focus, aria, keyboard).

Sofia (Eng-Platform): I'll prototype the sampling query param and reservoir approximate p99. PR target: next week.

Anna (Design): If no objections, I'll add these items to the Console sprint board. :thumbsup:

Miguel (Product): :thumbsup:

Mark (Eng-ML): :thumbsup:
